description: 17:15 - 18:45: Closed UPR and staged up pumps. 200 LPM 3 bar, 300 LPM 7 bar, 500 LPM 36 bar. At 750 LPM the SPP increased to 81 bar, then dropped to 41 bar. SPP slowly increased to 60 bar and remained stable between 58 bar and 60 bar.
